features: 🖥️ Ultra HD 4K Support: Elevate your viewing experience with the Lifelong Projector, featuring 1080p native resolution and compatibility with 4K video, offering unmatched clarity and detail in your home theatre.

🎬 Large Screen Display: Our smart projector can produce a massive 200-inch display, making it perfect for creating your own big-screen experience at home. It is ideal for anyone seeking an immersive, expansive visual setup.
🔄 180° Swivel: Easily adjust the projector’s angle to match your projection preference for optimal viewing in any room, ensuring a perfect setup every time.
🔊 Integrated Sound System: Comes equipped with a powerful 3W speaker that delivers clear, room-filling audio, ensuring an immersive sound experience for all your movies and presentations.
💡 Brilliant Brightness: With 3000 lumens of brightness, our home projector cuts through ambient light, delivering vibrant visuals in any setting, day or night.
📐 Accurate Image Adjustment: Hassle-free setup with Manual Focus and Auto Keystone correction, allowing you to achieve the perfect picture alignment quickly and easily.
